single_rule: lowest visible valid image ID per point; NOT one fixed global camera
weighted_rule: alpha=0 beta=1 absolute normal-view cosine; no segmentation probability weighting
shared_rules: same point rows, same track visibility, round pixels, same B5 cache, no GT-dependent filtering
limitation: weighted implementation uses insertion-order tie and labels zero-weight points; replay uses smallest-label tie and abstains zero-mass. Counts above establish whether frozen run is affected.
